stem.text: A stone is thrown upwards and follows a curved path.

stem.alt: Curved path drawn from a dot, with arrowheads along the path showing its direction.

stem.text: Why does the path have this shape?

A.text: The stone has a constant horizontal acceleration and constant vertical velocity.

B.text: The stone has a constant horizontal velocity and constant vertical acceleration.

C.text: The stone has a constant upward acceleration followed by a constant downward acceleration.

D.text: The stone has a constant upward velocity followed by a constant downward velocity.
